validation-failed.title: Missing or incorrect details
validation-failed.detail: The request could not be processed because some values are missing or are not in the expected form. Check the fields listed and try again.

registration.email_taken: An account already exists for this address, so a second one cannot be created. Sign in with that address instead, or ask for a password reset if you no longer remember it.
registration.password_policy: The password you chose does not meet the requirements, so the account was not created. Use between {minimum} and {maximum} characters, with at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter, one digit and one further character.

verification.token_invalid: This confirmation link is no longer valid, so the address has not been confirmed. Links last 24 hours and work only once — request a new one from the confirmation page.

email_verification.subject: Confirm your email address
email_verification.body:
Hello,

Someone created an easyesg account with this email address. Open the link below to confirm the address and activate the account:

{verificationUrl}

The link is valid for 24 hours and works only once.

If you did not create the account, ignore this message: without confirmation the account cannot be used, and it is deleted automatically after 7 days.
